data.one_liner: Support for multiple ARB and messages localization files for the intl package.
data.what_it_does: Allows using multiple ARB localization files and registering separate delegates for each. It solves the intl package limitation where only the first initializeMessages call is processed.
use_when: You need to add intl localization with ARB files to a separate package and use it in a main project with its own localization files.
You want to specify a fallback locale for your intl translations.
avoid_when: You only have a single localization file for your application.
strengths: Enables modular localization across different packages and the main app.
Supports overriding package localization strings inside the main project.
weaknesses: Providing a fallback locale loads all messages into memory at application start.
Requires manual setup in localization delegates instead of built-in generator support.
data.setup_notes: Replace initializeMessages with MultipleLocalizations.load inside your LocalizationsDelegate load method.

alternatives.name: easy_localization
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a comprehensive localization solution with JSON/YAML/CSV/TXT support without relying on the standard intl generator flow.

alternatives.name: slang
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers strongly typed localizations with code generation and multi-file support out of the box.
